svg.title: F1 Redis pause timeline
svg.desc: Responses per second on the fail-open and fail-closed endpoints from 10 s before to 40 s after a 20-second Redis pause at 2,000 RPS.
svg.text: Run 20261111T195013Z-f1-fixed_window-2000-r1. No 429 while Redis was down: fail-open answered 200 without limits, fail-closed answered 503. Source: Nginx access log.
